title: Sand Stream (Ability)
text:
Sand Stream (Japanese: すなおこし Sand Raising) is an Ability introduced in Generation III. Prior to Generation IV, it was the signature Ability of Tyranitar.

==== Generations III-V ====
Sand Stream summons a sandstorm in battle as soon as a Pokémon with Sand Stream enters the battle. Its effects almost are the same as Sandstorm's; the only difference is that instead of lasting for five turns, it lasts for the whole battle or until a different weather condition replaces it. If a Pokémon with Sand Stream is sent out in the same turn as another Pokémon whose Ability causes a different weather condition, the slower Pokémon's Ability will override the faster Pokémon's Ability.

==== Generation VI onward ====
The sandstorm will now last only for five turns. This can be extended to eight turns if the Pokémon is holding a Smooth Rock.
If heavy rain, extremely harsh sunlight, or strong winds are present, Sand Stream will fail to activate.

Sand Stream (Japanese: すなおこし Sand Raising) is an Ability introduced in Generation III. Prior to Generation IV, it was the signature Ability of Tyranitar.


== Effect ==


=== In battle ===


==== Generations III-V ====
Sand Stream summons a sandstorm in battle as soon as a Pokémon with Sand Stream enters the battle. Its effects almost are the same as Sandstorm's; the only difference is that instead of lasting for five turns, it lasts for the whole battle or until a different weather condition replaces it. If a Pokémon with Sand Stream is sent out in the same turn as another Pokémon whose Ability causes a different weather condition, the slower Pokémon's Ability will override the faster Pokémon's Ability.


==== Generation VI onward ====
The sandstorm will now last only for five turns. This can be extended to eight turns if the Pokémon is holding a Smooth Rock.
If heavy rain, extremely harsh sunlight, or strong winds are present, Sand Stream will fail to activate.


=== Outside of battle ===
Sand Stream has no effect outside of battle.

== In other games ==


=== Pokémon Mystery Dungeon series ===
In Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team, and Explorers of Time, Darkness, Sand Stream changes the weather to Sandstorm upon entering a floor, and then every subsequent 36 turns. 
In Super Mystery Dungeon, Sand Stream changes the weather to sandstorm upon entering a floor. Sandstorm lasts a certain number of turns (in multiples of 66) before clearing. After the weather has cleared, Sand Stream will again activate after waiting a certain number of turns (in multiples of 66).
